answer: Lock the work history, not the key. Hold earnings for 100 epochs before they can be spent. Publish every failure with the address attached. Bleed 4% of standing from every idle key each epoch, which strips the value out of parking. An attacker needs 100 epochs of real output per key before a single coin moves, and that number is what kills the model. A velvet front and an onyx profile do not survive a public failure list, and a willow does not hide a fence.
